summary: Phase 4 Slice B (dual-write cutover) verified GREEN end-to-end. Backend pytest: 23/23 PASS (test_iteration11_phase4b_dual_write.py). All 9 mutating routes now write to BOTH MongoDB and Supabase Postgres (Mongo authoritative, Postgres best-effort): POST /api/clients, DELETE /api/clients/{id}, PUT /api/clients/{id}/photo, PUT /api/users/{id}/photo, POST /api/assignments (idempotent on caregiver+client pair), DELETE /api/assignments/{id}, POST /api/clients/{id}/bulk-assign-onboarding, POST /api/client-tasks/{id}/toggle. GET /api/assignments now reads from Postgres and surfaces newly-created rows. Direct SUPABASE_DIRECT_URL probes confirm dual-write parity: created clients/assignments appear immediately in Postgres; deletes cascade automatically via ON DELETE CASCADE (verified by creating a client+assignment, deleting the client, and seeing the assignment disappear from Postgres without an explicit delete). Photo updates flush to both DBs (data: URI prefix stripped consistently). Idempotency: posting the same (caregiver_id, client_id) twice returns the same assignment id; Postgres row-count remains 1 for that pair. Toggle flips `completed` and `completed_at` symmetrically in both stores. Slice A regression: /api/auth/me, /api/caregivers, /api/clients, /api/stats all work under BOTH legacy HS256 (Admin@123) and Supabase ES256 (AdminPassword123!) JWTs. Non-Phase-4 routes (/api/documents=50, /api/onboarding, /api/shifts, /api/training) still serve Mongo. Frontend (Expo web preview, mobile viewport 390x844): legacy and Supabase logins both land on Dashboard showing 1 Client / 12 Caregivers / 50 Documents / 0 Trainings; Team tab loads Clients/Caregivers/Onboarding sub-tabs; Schedule tab shows Day/Week toggle. End-to-end UI flow created a 'TEST_PH4B_UI_Client', verified it appeared in the Clients list, deleted it via the delete-client-<uuid> button, and confirmed it was removed from BOTH Mongo (gone from UI list) and Postgres (direct asyncpg probe returned None). Final cleanup parity: PG clients=1, assignments=2, client_tasks=13 — exactly matches the Phase 3 baseline, zero drift.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:104-106 — Mongo insert happens before Postgres upsert (correct), but if the Postgres write logs a WARNING the route still returns 200 with no signal to the caller. Once Slice J flips authority to Postgres this best-effort behaviour will need a deprecation plan, otherwise silent drift could accumulate. Recommend adding a Prometheus counter (or at minimum a periodic reconcile job) for `supa_data._safe` failures so the team can see when dual-write divergence happens in prod.

server.py:1100-1111 — Idempotency on POST /api/assignments is checked against Mongo only (db.assignments.find_one). If a row exists in Postgres but not Mongo (drift), the route would happily create a new Mongo row and try to upsert against the existing Postgres id — but it would generate a fresh uuid, so the conflict would create a second Postgres row. Today this can't happen because Mongo is always written first, but worth tightening once Postgres becomes authoritative.

core/supa_data.py:142-148 — _safe swallows EVERY exception including programmer errors (e.g., a typo in SQL, asyncpg.InterfaceError on pool exhaustion). Consider letting asyncpg.PostgresSyntaxError / TypeError bubble up so dev-time regressions are caught loudly, while still catching ConnectionDoesNotExistError / DataError-style runtime issues.

server.py /api/users/{id}/photo (line 198-206) — splits data URI with `.split(',', 1)[-1]` which is fine, but does not validate the input is actually base64. A malformed photo_base64 like 'not-base64' would persist as-is into both DBs.
Reload watcher still includes /app/backend/tests/ — backend reloads when test files are edited (already noted in iteration_10, still present in iteration_11).
